scripts.build: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.render.config.ts
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => { for (const p of ['dist', 'render.js', 'coverage']) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.package: pnpm exec chips plugin pack --out dist/
